assessments.reasoning: The seven verified publisher ranges link sections 1.4 and 1.10’s coverage rules, section 1.13’s form definition and section 3.1’s recipient duties. Sections 1.7 and 3.3 explain why bundling separate outside material does not extend those duties to it and why the qualified additional-license route remains available.

limitations: Coverage depends on the source and its provenance. Section 3.3 permits chosen Larger Work terms and, under its separate conditions, additional licensing of eligible Covered Software.
reasoning: Section 3.1 requires MPL terms for distributed covered source, including Modifications the distributor makes or contributes to. Recipients must be told that MPL governs the source and how to obtain the license. The distributor must refrain from attempting to change or restrict their source rights.
